text: Legacy insurers will not underwrite smart contracts that sit outside the traditional legal framework, and even if they eventually enter the DApp market their actuarial risk assessment methods may be only partially compatible with rapidly evolving decentralized products.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization - A Primer on the New Economy (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3406323

isBasedOn.name: Decentralization - A Primer on the New Economy

abstract: Most legacy insurance companies will not consider underwriting a smart contract that is not subject to the traditional legal framework.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: legacy insurance companies facing smart contract risk
